scope: Initial Ready example-settings/playground only; offscreen GPU visual review

image_reviews.observation: Settings title and description readable; Docs/Playground/Behaviors then Edge cases/Reset wrap at whole words; Disabled/Error do not overlap Workspace name, Studio field or helper.

Workspace name, Studio, helper, Enable notifications, Save/settings and Ready status are distinct and readable. Edge cases/Reset are partly above the ordinary scroll clip; no intrinsic text truncation. Save/settings wraps between whole words.

Helper, Enable notifications, Save/settings and full Ready message precede the empty Event log heading with clear separation; footer fully reachable at actual offset 402. Empty event log is expected initial state.
